source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 3 Food 词表(主词条真词,△ 补充词与专名跳过);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、食物/饮食文化主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The smell of the soup made me recall my grandmother's cooking.
words.example_cn: 那汤的香味让我回想起奶奶做的饭。

words.example_en: New eating habits often emerge when people move to another country.
words.example_cn: 人们移居他国时,新的饮食习惯常常会出现。

words.example_en: Adjusting to foreign food is just one phase of culture shock.
words.example_cn: 适应外国食物只是文化冲击的一个阶段。

words.meaning_cn: 偶然碰到;意外遇见;邂逅
words.example_en: I encountered many new dining customs during my stay in France.
words.example_cn: 在法国期间我遇到了许多新的就餐习俗。

words.example_en: Many Americans tend to keep one hand in their lap while eating.
words.example_cn: 许多美国人吃饭时往往把一只手放在大腿上。

words.example_en: The French say "Bon appétit!" to wish you a good appetite before a meal.
words.example_cn: 法国人在餐前说"Bon appétit!"祝你有好胃口。

words.example_en: I often grab a quick coffee at a café near my host family's home.
words.example_cn: 我常在寄宿家庭附近的咖啡馆匆匆喝杯咖啡。

words.example_en: Each region of China has its own type of typical dish.
words.example_cn: 中国每个地区都有自己典型的菜肴种类。

words.example_en: We grow up eating the food of our culture and learn to identify with it.
words.example_cn: 我们从小吃本民族的食物,并学会认同它。

words.example_en: As adults, we often seek comfort food when we feel sad.
words.example_cn: 成年后,我们难过时常会寻找慰藉食物。

words.meaning_cn: 焦虑不安的;心力交瘁的
words.example_en: Whenever I feel tired or stressed, I remember my mum's soup.
words.example_cn: 每当我感到疲惫或焦虑时,就会想起妈妈做的汤。

words.example_en: Food is an important expression of cultural identity.
words.example_cn: 食物是文化身份的重要表达。

words.example_en: Chinese cuisine balances salty, spicy, sour, sweet and bitter flavours.
words.example_cn: 中餐讲究咸、辣、酸、甜、苦五味的平衡。

words.meaning_cn: 受珍爱的;珍贵的;珍稀的
words.example_en: Families pass down precious recipes from one generation to the next.
words.example_cn: 家庭把珍贵的食谱一代代传下去。

words.example_en: My grandmother's noodle recipe has been kept for sixty years.
words.example_cn: 我奶奶的面条食谱已经保存了六十年。

words.example_en: Cooking traditional food is a means of coping with homesickness.
words.example_cn: 烹饪传统食物是排解思乡之情的一种方式。

words.example_en: Each community's unique cuisine reflects its history and values.
words.example_cn: 每个社群独特的饮食都反映了它的历史与价值观。

words.meaning_cn: 信念;相信;认为正确的事物
words.example_en: A nation's food reflects its lifestyle, values and beliefs.
words.example_cn: 一个民族的食物反映了它的生活方式、价值观和信念。

words.example_en: In China, harmony is a vital trait shown in balanced dishes.
words.example_cn: 在中国,和谐是一项重要特质,体现在味道平衡的菜肴中。

words.example_en: Balance is a vital part of cooking a good Chinese meal.
words.example_cn: 平衡是做好一顿中餐必不可少的部分。

words.example_en: Almost every flavour is used in a balanced way in Chinese dishes.
words.example_cn: 中餐几乎将每一种味道都用得恰到好处。

words.example_en: People in Sichuan are famous for their love of spicy food.
words.example_cn: 四川人以爱吃辣闻名。

words.example_en: Lemons have a strong sour taste that many people enjoy.
words.example_cn: 柠檬有强烈的酸味,许多人很喜欢。

words.example_en: Some green vegetables have a slightly bitter taste.
words.example_cn: 有些绿色蔬菜带有淡淡的苦味。

words.example_en: Chinese people have a historically elaborate cooking style.
words.example_cn: 中国人历来有一种讲究精细的烹饪风格。

words.example_en: A people's careful style shows in their costumes as well as their food.
words.example_cn: 一个民族讲究的风格既体现在服装上,也体现在食物上。

words.example_en: They believe food should be nutritious as well as appealing.
words.example_cn: 他们认为食物既要有营养,也要诱人。

words.example_en: A colourful, appealing dish makes people want to start eating.
words.example_cn: 色彩丰富、诱人的菜肴让人想立刻动筷。

words.example_en: As the world becomes globalised, we can easily access cuisines from other cultures.
words.example_cn: 随着世界全球化,我们能轻松接触到其他文化的菜系。

words.example_en: We should become more informed about other cultures by trying their dishes.
words.example_cn: 我们应通过品尝别国菜肴,更多地了解其他文化。

words.example_en: Many French traditions focus on food and special cakes.
words.example_cn: 许多法国传统都围绕食物和特别的蛋糕。

words.example_en: We attended a dinner party to celebrate the New Year together.
words.example_cn: 我们参加了一场晚宴一起庆祝新年。

words.example_en: A French dinner party often includes multiple courses.
words.example_cn: 法国晚宴常常有好几道菜。

words.example_en: The meal had a variety of cheeses and slices of fresh bread.
words.example_cn: 这顿饭有各种各样的奶酪和新鲜面包片。

words.example_en: My host family welcomed me warmly to their dinner table.
words.example_cn: 我的寄宿家庭热情地把我迎到他们的餐桌前。

words.example_en: Different countries observe very different dining customs.
words.example_cn: 不同国家遵循着十分不同的就餐习俗。

words.example_en: I learned useful strategies for dealing with culture shock.
words.example_cn: 我学到了应对文化冲击的实用策略。

words.example_en: She used a line graph to illustrate the highs and lows of the experience.
words.example_cn: 她用一张折线图来说明这段经历的起起伏伏。

words.example_en: Many French traditions focus on food and the family table.
words.example_cn: 许多法国传统都聚焦于食物和家庭餐桌。

words.example_en: A Chinese dinner usually starts with some cold dishes.
words.example_cn: 中式晚餐通常以几道凉菜开始。

words.example_en: Each region of China has its own typical New Year dishes.
words.example_cn: 中国每个地区都有自己典型的年节菜肴。

words.example_en: Immigration introduced many different ingredients to American cooking.
words.example_cn: 移民为美国烹饪带来了许多不同的食材。

words.phrase_en: from one generation to the next
words.example_en: Traditional cuisine is passed down from one generation to the next.
words.example_cn: 传统菜肴一代代地传承下去。

words.example_en: Immigrants cook traditional food as a way of preserving their culture.
words.example_cn: 移民们烹饪传统食物,以此保存自己的文化。

words.example_en: A good Chinese dish needs a careful balance of flavours.
words.example_cn: 一道好的中式菜肴需要仔细的味道平衡。

words.example_en: In a more globalised world, foreign dishes are easy to find.
words.example_cn: 在一个更加全球化的世界里,外国菜很容易找到。

words.example_en: Boiling and steaming are two common cooking methods in China.
words.example_cn: 煮和蒸是中国两种常见的烹饪方法。

words.example_en: Family dishes often become the comfort food we seek as adults.
words.example_cn: 家常菜常常成为我们成年后寻求的慰藉食物。
